name: Information Blockade Around the Chornobyl Disaster (1986) (C0090)

techniques.comment: Creation of an artificial picture of radiological well-being and the criminal, forced marching of people into the May Day demonstrations in Kyiv under radioactive fallout to mask the catastrophe(Citation: Двойное преступление СССР: как советы скрывали Чернобыльскую катастрофу 2026).

Deliberate concealment by the union leadership in Moscow of the scale of the Chornobyl NPP disaster from its own population and international organizations, depriving Ukrainians of information about the level of the radiation threat(Citation: Двойное преступление СССР: как советы скрывали Чернобыльскую катастрофу 2026).
